A one-page summary that `05-outputs.qmd` renders with `save_notebook()` and
`06-publishing.qmd` publishes. It reads the analysis file from notebook 02.

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

import framework as fw
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fw.scaffold()
bp = fw.data_read("inputs.final.bp_analysis")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
summary = (
    bp.groupby(["treatment", "visit_number"])["systolic_bp"]
    .agg(["count", "mean"])
    .round(1)
    .unstack("treatment")
)
summary
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Mean systolic blood pressure by visit and treatment arm"
means = bp.groupby(["visit_number", "treatment"])["systolic_bp"].mean().unstack()
ax = means.plot(marker="o", figsize=(6, 3.5))
ax.set_xlabel("Visit")
ax.set_ylabel("Systolic BP (mmHg)")
ax.set_xticks(means.index)
plt.show()
```
